Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game. Join us back on 14th of this month for the 3rd game at 3.15 pm IST (9.45 am GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Najmul Hossain Shanto wins the Player of the Match award. He says he is happy after the knock. Adds Towhid Hridoy batted really well and took the pressure off him in the middle. Shares they feel like home here with the support.

Tamim Iqbal starts by thanking the crowd for the support. Adds the total was gettable as the wicket was good one. Says it was pleasing to see how Towhid Hridoy and Shanto batted. Mentions he is pleased with his squad.
...Presentation time...

For Ireland, they began well but as the ball got old, it got easier to score and Bangladesh capitalized. They scored quickly and Ireland were unable to contain them. In the end, Bangladesh completed a very good win to take a 1-0 lead in the series. Hard one for them, they did the job with the bat, the likes of Harry Tector and George Dockrell stepped up but in vain in the end.

That’s some chase from Bangladesh! We felt the score was quite over par but they have gunned it down with some ease. Shanto was the star. He batted brilliantly. Attacked the bowlers and it came off. He scored a brilliant ton and the others did their job too. The likes of Towhid Hridoy played brilliantly and he provided the much-needed impetus. It came down to the last over but the experienced Rahim kept his cool and took them over the line.
FOUR! Rahim has done it! Short in length and on middle. Rahim scoops it over to third man for a boundary. Pressure got big on Adair. Bangladesh win by 3 wickets.
